why: Both correctly steer away from refusing out of fear. Advice 2 is better calibrated: it asks whether the 12M yen is recurring or a one-time fee, points out the 25% dependence on one customer, and gets the churn math right (about 30,000 yen of extra loss a month, not 60,000). Advice 1 has sharper deadlines and thresholds, but it assumes the deal renews every year and brushes off the asker's worry about being pushed around.
